grid.teamDesc: Cadillac Racing represented General Motors' return to top-level prototype endurance racing with the all-new Cadillac V-Series.R. The program combined decades of American motorsport engineering experience with global endurance racing ambitions, competing against the world's leading manufacturers in the Hypercar category. Backed directly by Cadillac and operated with factory support, the team quickly established itself as a serious challenger for podiums and victories in the FIA World Endurance Championship.

Ferrari AF Corse represented Ferrari's long-awaited return to endurance racing's top category after fifty years away from the premier prototype class. Partnering with AF Corse, one of the most successful GT racing organizations in modern motorsport, Ferrari developed the 499P Hypercar to compete for overall victories at Le Mans and in the FIA World Endurance Championship. The project instantly became one of the sport's most significant factory programs.

Ferrari AF Corse represented Ferrari's long-awaited return to endurance racing's top category after fifty years away from the premier prototype class. Partnering with AF Corse, one of the most successful GT racing organizations in modern motorsport, Ferrari developed the 499P Hypercar to compete for overall victories at Le Mans and in the FIA World Endurance Championship. The project instantly became one of the sport's most significant factory programs.

Glickenhaus Racing embodied the independent spirit of endurance racing through its bespoke 007 LMH Hypercar program. Founded by entrepreneur and automotive enthusiast Jim Glickenhaus, the team sought to compete directly against major global manufacturers using a purpose-built racing prototype. Despite operating with significantly smaller resources than many rivals, Glickenhaus earned widespread respect for taking on the sport's largest brands at the highest level.

Peugeot TotalEnergies marked the French manufacturer's return to top-flight endurance racing with the radical Peugeot 9X8 Hypercar. Designed with innovative engineering concepts and supported by multinational energy partner TotalEnergies, the program represented Peugeot's ambition to challenge for overall victories on the world stage. The team combined factory resources, technological innovation, and experienced drivers in pursuit of endurance racing success.

Peugeot TotalEnergies marked the French manufacturer's return to top-flight endurance racing with the radical Peugeot 9X8 Hypercar. Designed with innovative engineering concepts and supported by multinational energy partner TotalEnergies, the program represented Peugeot's ambition to challenge for overall victories on the world stage. The team combined factory resources, technological innovation, and experienced drivers in pursuit of endurance racing success.

Porsche Penske Motorsport united one of the most successful sports car manufacturers in history with the championship-winning expertise of Team Penske. Created to lead Porsche's global prototype racing effort, the operation brought together elite engineering, operational excellence, and decades of endurance racing success. The Porsche 963 was developed to continue the brand's legacy of overall victories at the world's most prestigious endurance events.

Porsche Penske Motorsport united one of the most successful sports car manufacturers in history with the championship-winning expertise of Team Penske. Created to lead Porsche's global prototype racing effort, the operation brought together elite engineering, operational excellence, and decades of endurance racing success. The Porsche 963 was developed to continue the brand's legacy of overall victories at the world's most prestigious endurance events.

Hertz Team JOTA was one of endurance racing's most accomplished independent organizations, known for consistently outperforming expectations against factory-backed rivals. Running a customer Porsche 963, the team combined elite operational execution, strategic expertise, and a proven record of success in prototype racing. The partnership between JOTA, Porsche, and title sponsor Hertz created one of the strongest privateer efforts on the Hypercar grid.

Proton Competition is one of Germany's most respected endurance racing organizations and has enjoyed a long relationship with Porsche in international sports car racing. As the first customer Porsche 963 operation in the WEC Hypercar era, the team demonstrated the viability of privateer participation at the highest level while leveraging decades of experience in endurance competition.

Toyota Gazoo Racing entered 2023 as the benchmark organization in endurance racing after multiple world championships and Le Mans victories. The GR010 Hybrid showcased Toyota's advanced hybrid technology and extensive motorsport expertise developed through years of competition at the highest level. With a factory-backed operation and world-class driver lineup, the team remained the standard by which every Hypercar competitor was measured.

The GR010 Hybrid showcased Toyota's advanced hybrid technology and extensive motorsport expertise developed through years of competition at the highest level. With a factory-backed operation and world-class driver lineup, the team remained the standard by which every Hypercar competitor was measured.

Floyd Vanwall Racing Team revived one of motorsport's most historic names through the Vanwall Vandervell 680 Hypercar program. The project sought to reintroduce the legendary British marque to top-level endurance racing while competing against well-funded factory manufacturers. With experienced international drivers and a distinctive independent spirit, the team became one of the most unique entries on the 2023 grid.

ORT by TF Sport has grown into one of Aston Martin’s most trusted endurance racing partners, earning victories and championships through consistent performances on some of the world’s toughest circuits. Campaigning the Aston Martin Vantage GTE, the British squad blends technical precision, experienced personnel, and a racer-first mentality that has made it a fixture at the front of GT competition. For drivers seeking a team that combines proven results with a family atmosphere and unwavering determination, ORT by TF Sport represents an ideal platform for success.

NorthWest AMR proudly represents Aston Martin’s enduring presence in international GT racing, bringing together experienced personnel and competitive drivers under one of the sport’s most iconic brands. Operating the Aston Martin Vantage GTE, the team embraces the challenge of endurance racing with determination, professionalism, and a commitment to continuous improvement. For competitors seeking a team built upon tradition, resilience, and ambition, NorthWest AMR offers the chance to race beneath the wings of a legendary manufacturer.

D'Station Racing has become a fan favorite through its unique identity, international presence, and long-standing partnership with Aston Martin. The Japanese team has steadily developed into a respected contender in endurance racing, combining disciplined preparation with a never-quit attitude. Racing the Aston Martin Vantage GTE, D'Station provides drivers an opportunity to represent one of Asia’s most recognizable GT programs while competing on the world’s biggest endurance racing stages.

Corvette Racing stands as one of the most iconic factory-backed programs in endurance racing history, with decades of success at Le Mans, Sebring, Daytona, and beyond. Operating the fearsome Corvette C8.R, the American squad is renowned for meticulous preparation, engineering excellence, and an unmatched commitment to performance. Built upon a legacy of victories against the world's best manufacturers, Corvette Racing offers competitors the opportunity to wear one of motorsport’s most respected badges while pursuing glory on racing’s biggest stages.

AF Corse is one of endurance racing’s most legendary organizations, having built its reputation through championship-winning campaigns with Ferrari across GT and prototype competition. Fielding the Ferrari 488 GTE Evo, the Italian powerhouse combines elite engineering, strategic excellence, and decades of Le Mans experience into a package capable of competing for victories at every level of endurance racing. With a culture built around professionalism and success, AF Corse offers drivers the opportunity to join one of motorsport’s most respected and accomplished teams while continuing a legacy defined by trophies, teamwork, and relentless pursuit of excellence.

AF Corse’s No. 54 operation continues the team’s tradition of excellence, providing a competitive environment where experienced racers and rising talent come together under one of Ferrari’s most successful customer programs. Backed by world-class engineering and championship-caliber strategy, the Ferrari 488 GTE Evo remains a formidable contender throughout the endurance racing calendar. Drivers joining this effort become part of a team whose expectations are simple: compete hard, perform consistently, and challenge for victory whenever the opportunity arises.

Kessel Racing has spent years establishing itself as one of Ferrari’s most recognizable customer teams, earning success across a wide range of GT championships and endurance events. Behind the wheel of the Ferrari 488 GTE Evo, the Swiss-based operation pairs technical experience with a passion for competition that has become its trademark. Known for professionalism, consistency, and an unwavering love of racing, Kessel Racing gives drivers the opportunity to join a respected organization that continues to challenge for top results around the world.

Richard Mille AF Corse unites the championship-winning expertise of AF Corse with the prestige and ambition associated with one of motorsport’s most recognizable premium partners. Racing the Ferrari 488 GTE Evo, the team benefits from elite resources, experienced personnel, and a proven ability to challenge at the front of the field. Combining performance, professionalism, and a relentless desire to win, Richard Mille AF Corse offers drivers the chance to join an operation where expectations are high and success is always the target.

Project 1 - AO Racing combines German endurance racing expertise with an ambitious competitive spirit that has earned respect throughout international GT competition. Racing the Porsche 911 RSR-19, the team embraces Porsche’s rich motorsport heritage while developing its own reputation for resilience and determination. Whether fighting through difficult races or capitalizing on race-winning opportunities, Project 1 - AO delivers an environment where commitment and teamwork are rewarded with the chance to compete against the very best in endurance racing.

Iron Lynx rapidly emerged as one of endurance racing’s premier GT organizations, building a reputation through major victories, championship fights, and strong manufacturer partnerships. Campaigning the Porsche 911 RSR-19, the team brings together elite engineering talent, innovative preparation, and a relentless competitive mentality. For racers looking to compete within a modern organization committed to growth and success, Iron Lynx offers a chance to be part of a team constantly pushing toward the next milestone.

Dempsey-Proton Racing has become synonymous with Porsche endurance racing, combining decades of experience with a reputation for extracting maximum performance from every program it undertakes. Long respected throughout Le Mans and world championship competition, the team thrives on discipline, preparation, and race-day execution. Joining Dempsey-Proton means becoming part of a storied organization that values commitment, rewards consistency, and embraces the challenge of competing at the highest level of GT racing.

Iron Dames has become one of motorsport’s most inspirational and recognizable projects, demonstrating that ambition, talent, and determination can break barriers on the world stage. Competing with the Porsche 911 RSR-19, the team has earned admiration throughout endurance racing while consistently fighting for strong results against established rivals. More than simply a racing team, Iron Dames represents a movement driven by passion, opportunity, and excellence, making it one of the most exciting programs in international motorsport.

GR Racing has built its reputation through perseverance, professionalism, and a deep passion for endurance competition. Running the Ferrari 488 GTE Evo, the team consistently punches above its weight by maximizing opportunities and delivering strong performances against larger organizations. With a culture centered on teamwork and continuous improvement, GR Racing provides drivers the opportunity to join a close-knit group committed to competing with heart, determination, and pride.

Proton Competition is among the most respected names in Porsche customer racing, with years of success spanning endurance championships and multiple appearances at the 24 Hours of Le Mans. Fielding the Porsche 911 RSR-19, the German squad combines technical expertise, race-winning experience, and one of the strongest support structures in GT racing. Drivers joining Proton Competition become part of an organization that understands what it takes to succeed on the global stage and possesses the tools necessary to compete for top honors.
